svg.title: SILLAS//HEAD — personal firmware / unstable build
svg.desc: A fictional retro computer interface. Sleep exceeds the meter. A pixel-art game inventory hides a sword, red boxing glove and save disk. Two sarcastic incident reports: I automate the boring parts so I can waste time on more sophisticated problems. If "it works" is an architecture, duct tape is an enterprise framework. No actual telemetry.

g.text: ITEMS FOUND IN THE SOURCE CODE
so I can waste time on more
NO STATS CARD / NO SKILL CLOUD / NO REMORSE
